description: Shared Renovate preset for DPYC ecosystem repos. Tuned for LOW NOISE: one weekly batch, throttled PR volume, aggressively grouped, and settled-release-only. The ONLY thing that self-merges is the tollbooth-dpyc == pin (patch/minor) — and only where the repo grants the Renovate app a branch-protection bypass. Everything else waits for owner review by design (crypto/PII federation: a human sees every dependency change). platformAutomerge is FALSE on purpose: our repos gate merges with a ruleset that grants the Renovate app (Integration) a bypass, and GitHub's native auto-merge does NOT honor ruleset bypass — it parks a green PR forever. Direct merge (platformAutomerge:false) uses the app's bypass and actually lands. OSV vulnerability alerts are ON: Renovate detects and opens security bump PRs fleet-wide (no LLM) — dependency CVEs are Renovate's job, never the Journeyman's.

packageRules.description: SDK pin — keep tollbooth-dpyc pinned to the exact == version on every update type. (rangeStrategy lives in its OWN rule: Renovate rejects combining it with matchUpdateTypes.) SCHEDULE EXEMPTION: the SDK is first-party and released deliberately, so it does not wait for the weekly window. minimumReleaseAge:0 below already said 'do not wait for it to settle' — but the global schedule still gated PR creation to Mondays 00:00-06:59, and the schedule won, so the exemption bought nothing. v0.89.1 (the courier rendezvous fix) was cut on a Wednesday and would have sat published-but-undelivered for five days. Everything else keeps the Monday batch.
SDK patch/minor — the ONE thing that self-merges (via a per-repo Renovate branch-protection bypass), on green CI; not delayed by minimumReleaseAge because we trust our own wheel immediately.
SDK major bumps — always manual review (breaking changes).
All GitHub Actions bumps collapsed into ONE PR; owner reviews (only the SDK pin bypasses the money-gate).

The fleet's Python version is an architectural decision, not a tracked dependency — every repo is deliberately single-3.12, and moving off it is one fleet migration, not six drive-by CI bumps. Renovate must not propose it at all. MATCHED BY DEP NAME ON PURPOSE: the github-actions manager reports this as depName 'python' but packageName 'actions/python-versions', so the previous rule's matchPackageNames:['python'] never matched anything. That rule shipped 2026-04-16 and looked like it was holding the line; it was inert the whole time, and on 2026-08-24 Renovate opened 3.14 bumps in SIX repos in one scheduled run. Four of them failed CI on coincurve 21.0.0, which has no 3.14 wheel and whose source build dies in cffi's LICENSE check.
Collapse all non-SDK Python dependency bumps into one PR.
Collapse all npm/frontend dependency bumps into one PR (tames the taxsort + excalibur churn).
